title: 第3章 玲珑你来真的第4章 莫欺中年穷
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 【你选择1。
【漆黑的夜，冰冷的风，你在山林里狂奔。
【你要去白云县城，投靠你的三姐。
【白云县紧挨着青河县，两个县城相距不算太远，你知道大概的方向。
【十几天后。
【你一路逃命，远离黑石帮的追捕。
【你靠着野果、野味果腹，偶尔路过村庄就去村子里偷点粮食，差点被村民当成野人抓住。
【“再翻过一座山，就到白云县城了……”
【此时的你蓬头垢面，满身泥泞，如果不是双眼依然炯炯有神，都看不出个人样了。
【忽然，一群人影从林子里蹿出，堵住你的去路。
【“此山是我栽！
此树是我开……”
【熟悉的开场白。
【你遭遇山贼了。
【领头的还是个女山贼，膀大腰圆，四层下巴，满脸横肉。
【一看吨位就知道是个高手。
【“女侠，我没钱……”
【女山贼把你里里外外都搜了一遍，不知为何，你感觉她好像还趁机占了便宜，多次对你实施攻鸡。
【“果然是个穷鬼！”
【你心下稍安。
【你知道山贼都是图财，没钱他们应该不会为难。
content_en:
[You choose 1.
[Dark night, icy wind, you are running wildly in the mountains and forests.
[You are going to Baiyun County to seek refuge with your third sister.
[Baiyun County is next to Qinghe County. The two counties are not too far apart. You know the general direction.
[Ten days later.
[You run for your life all the way, away from the pursuit of the Blackstone Gang.
[You rely on wild fruits and game to satisfy your hunger. Occasionally you pass by a village and steal some food from the village. You are almost caught by the villagers as a savage.
["Climb another mountain and you will arrive at Baiyun County..."
[At this time, you are disheveled and covered with mud. If it weren’t for your bright eyes, you wouldn’t be able to tell who you are.
[Suddenly, a group of figures jump out from the woods, blocking your way.
【"I planted this mountain!"
I planted this tree..."
[Familiar opening remarks.
[You encountered bandits.
[The leader is still a female bandit, with big shoulders, a round chin, and a face full of flesh.
[You can tell he is a master just by looking at the tonnage.
["Xia Xia, I have no money..."
[The female bandit searched you inside and out. For some reason, you felt like she took advantage of you and attacked you many times.
["He is indeed a poor man!"
[Please feel at ease.
[You know that bandits are all looking for money. They shouldn’t be in trouble if they don’t have money.
title_en: Chapter 3 Linglong, you are serious Chapter 4 Don’t bully the middle-aged and poor
